rule.daa.bot_mode.description: Bots fill every empty chair, so one player can open a table. Turn it off to require five real players.
rule.daa.bot_skill.description: Relaxed: beats whatever it can, saves nothing and ignores its partner. Normal: knows its partner and keeps the four special cards for their moment. Fierce: takes every four-recycle and bombs when an opponent is nearly out.
rule.daa.reveal_sub_a.description: Announce both holders of the big aces at the deal. Off, the second holder stays hidden until their big ace is played.
rule.daa.show_hints.description: Label the pile with the shape that was played.
message.daa.game_started: Big A: two decks are being dealt.
message.daa.trump_announce: The big aces are the %s aces -- call the moment you draw one.
message.daa.called: %s calls the big A and takes the main chair!
message.daa.called_sub: %s calls the second big A -- both aces are out in the open!
message.daa.sub_a_called: The second ace %s called itself, so both big aces are face up.
message.daa.call_hint: You drew a big ace -- hit Call big A (C) to claim the main chair!
message.daa.call_done: You have already called your big ace.
message.daa.call_wait: Draw a big ace and you can call it.
message.daa.trump_is: The big aces are the %s aces.
message.daa.main_a_is: %s holds a big ace and leads.
message.daa.double_a: Both big aces are in one hand: the holder is alone.
message.daa.single_a: This deck holds a single big ace: its holder plays alone.
message.charta.try_finding_another: Try another one -- any poker deck plays; the double deck in the Decks creative tab is the full game.
message.daa.sub_a_is: The second big ace is with %s.
message.daa.sub_a_hidden: The second big ace stays hidden.
message.daa.sub_a_revealed: %s plays a big ace and shows as the second holder!
message.daa.illegal_play: %s plays something that does not fit.
message.daa.recycled: %s takes %s cards back with a four.
message.daa.head: %s is out first.
message.daa.needs_five: Big A needs exactly five players.
message.daa.needs_deck: Big A needs a double deck of 108 cards, jokers included.
editor.daa.hint: F9 layout: drag to move, scroll to scale, right click to reset, R resets hovered (auto-saved, S also saves)
deck.daa.double: Double deck - full Big A (108 cards)
